diagnosis: No typed operation currently enumerates all visible windows without a known process/title selector.

evidence.fact: window.resolve requires nonwhitespace process; limit1-50 only bounds matches. Description supports process name or title with byTitle.
resolve unconditionally reads process. window.active only calls ResolveForegroundAsync.
Empty selector is invalid. Process matching is exact, title matching uses named application/title identity. No all/wildcard branch; enumeration stops at limit.
Empty selector is tested as invalid; not an implicit inventory request.

correction: The initial H0023 window.resolve proposal belongs to the window domain, but is not directly executable for list-all under this contract. Earlier claims that a correct executable read was merely vetoed were too strong.
next: Establish a real bounded window inventory contract/provider before measuring LLM recovery for list-all. Prefer reusing discovery responsibility where it preserves requested scope and truthful partial-result reporting; inspect heritage before choosing final design.
probe707_limit: Expected_domain=True only means a desktop-window topic. It does not establish full operation compatibility, existing capability, correct arguments or product success. Pure plural patch remains unadopted.

heritage.finding: Top-level OS window tool included list separately from browser tabs; no pagination/truncation contract given.
Global visible-window snapshots used EnumWindows with positions and process identity; no bounded inventory or pagination contract given.
